## About Me

I am an Industrial Engineering student at the University of Arkansas with an interest in problem solving, teamwork, and improving processes. Through my coursework and work experiences, I have developed skills in communication, organization, leadership, and working effectively with others.

I enjoy learning new things, taking on challenges, and finding ways to make processes more efficient. My experience as a Resident Assistant has also helped me strengthen my leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills while working with a diverse group of people.

As I continue my education, I am interested in gaining professional experience that allows me to apply what I have learned in the classroom while continuing to grow my technical and interpersonal skills. I am especially interested in opportunities where I can work with others, solve problems, and contribute to meaningful projects.
